$comment: Collates the ingest envelope into the IR — an in-memory DATA STRUCTURE (successor of the LTS JSON monolith), never emitted as an artifact; wire naming and arrangement (sort/group/shard/idx) are writer concerns. READ BY CODE: rs.core.assemble loads out.entry.core and out.entry.exclude at import — those two lists are this stage's projection semantics, declared here and nowhere else. in.bag names what assemble actually READS from a bag; out.entry says what an entry IS: core (guaranteed, not counted in Header.Elements) + everything else the bag carried (elements, counted) − exclude. Adding an ingestion-side field upstream that must not reach the payload = add it to out.entry.exclude; forgetting makes it ride into the payload as an element, which the golden test catches.

RunContext.note: run-level header material stamped VERBATIM (RunStamp, Root, GeneratorVersion, ConfigEcho, Timing, Environment, GitHistory, …); EntryCount and Elements are RESERVED — carrying either throws

Adapter.note: track adapter; Code = one result → one entry (Thread lands with the thread-corpus milestone)

EntryRouting.note: LeanPayload (default): read failures / null / empty content route to Diagnostics.Routed and never become entries. KeepContentless: LTS-style, every non-null result is an entry

RelativePath.note: routing records name the item by it

Content.note: LeanPayload: absent/non-string → NoContent; '' → EmptyFile or EmptiedByProcessing

SizeBytes.note: LeanPayload: distinguishes EmptyFile (0 on disk) from EmptiedByProcessing

ReadError.note: LeanPayload: routes with its kind as Reason; KeepContentless: retained

_ChainHalt.note: LeanPayload: routes as ChainHalt when no ReadError

Entries.note: CANONICAL INGESTED ORDER (store order); all sorting/grouping/sharding is emission-side

Skipped.note: pre-chain skips passed through verbatim; distinct from Diagnostics.Routed

Diagnostics.note: feed for the diagnostic sidecar — never rendered into payloads

Elements.note: assemble-derived: { <name>: { Count; Total } } — observed presence per non-core entry field; payload self-description + coverage

Content.note: may be absent/empty only under KeepContentless

entry.$tiers: FOUR dispositions, not three (2026-08-23). core = guaranteed on every entry, not counted in Elements. carried = survives onto the entry for DOWNSTREAM STAGES, not counted in Elements, never a wire column unless container.spec.jsonc names one — the slot a crawl-derived fact needs when it is neither payload material nor an enrichment. exclude = stripped from the bag. elements = everything else (the open enrichment model). Before the carried tier existed, keeping a fact available downstream meant making it look like an enrichment, so facts with a real late consumer were excluded and re-derived instead — `Extension` was computed at crawl, carried three stages, destroyed here, and re-derived by shards for ByFileType grouping. Two derivations that must agree is a defect class; one carried field is not.

elements.note: every other bag field, arrival order preserved (Encoding, ContentMeta, Processing, …); ReadError is an element only under KeepContentless

Routed.note: @{ Index; RelativePath; Reason } — NullResult | <ReadError kind> | ChainHalt | NoContent | EmptyFile | EmptiedByProcessing
